[[Jin the Skull Bow]] is a [[Crimson Skull]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Sunqua Vale]].

== Location ==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Sunqua Vale}} (near the exit into [[Kinya Province]])

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Called Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Kindle Arrows}}
* {{skill icon|Marauder's Shot}} 

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Bolt of Linen]]
* [[Copper Crimson Skull Coin]]
* [[Crimson Skull Boots]]
* [[Jin's Hornbow]] ([[unique]])
* [[Silver Crimson Skull Coin]]

== Notes ==
* She appears to be alone as you approach.  Once attacked, a [[Crimson Skull Raider]] and a [[Crimson Skull Hunter]] [[popup|drop down from the trees]] to attack.
* Does not spawn during the [[Dragon Festival]] [[quest]] [[A Strange Request]].
* Because Jin is very close to the portal to Kinya Province it is easy to [[farm]] her for experience or drops.  For a [[Ranger]] farmer, a longbow is recommended to make sure the Crimson Skull Raider and the Crimson Skull Hunter aren't [[aggro]]'ed.

== Trivia ==
* When approaching her at about casting [[range]], Jin will do a /salute [[emote]]. 
** This behavior can be difficult to spot when approaching from the south, however, as Jin will often turn hostile before you can get close enough.
